{{Quote|<nowiki />''[&hellip;]'' while I don't need to see an abandoned bunker or a black spot where someone put a Sith Lord to the torch, I would like to see that diamond core they found around the Din Pulsar.|Beryl Suttrige|<ref name="Endor" />}}
The '''Din Pulsar''' was located in the [[Din system]], a part of the [[Din Nebula/Legends|Din Nebula]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]]. It was formed when a [[Din supernova|supernova]] [[Supernova/Legends|destroyed]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Din]] around [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], and it retained in its [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] the three cores of the former star's [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. [[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] later, the [[Magnet/Legends|magnetic]] pulses emitted by the [[Pulsar/Legends|pulsar]] hindered travel along the nearby [[Trindello-Endor Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].

==Description==
The Din Pulsar was a remnant of a [[Din supernova|supernova]] that [[Supernova/Legends|destroyed]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Din]] around [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. Situated within the [[Din system]],<ref name="Endor" /> it lay within the [[Outer Moddell systems]] area of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]],<ref name="EAOC Din" /> one of the [[Sector/Legends|subsectors]] making up the [[Inner Zuma Region]]<ref name="TEA" /> within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Zuma sector/Legends|Zuma sector]].<ref name="EAOC Din" /> The Din [[Star system/Legends|system]] was situated adjacent to the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Trindello-Endor Route]], which connected it to the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor]] and [[Trindello system/Legends|Trindello systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

The whirling and flashing [[Pulsar/Legends|pulsar]] was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by the three cores&mdash;one of them a [[Diamond/Legends|diamond]] the size of a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]]&mdash;of Din's former outer [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]]&ndash;type planets. The Din Pulsar was also surrounded by the [[Nebula/Legends|nebulosity]] known as the [[Din Nebula/Legends|Din Nebula]].<ref name="Endor" />

==History==
During the [[Standard century/Legends|century]] leading up to the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]],<ref name="Endor" /> which began in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the combination of [[Magnet/Legends|magnetic]] pulses emitted by the Din Pulsar and filaments of [[Gas/Legends|gas]] from the Din Nebula made the Trindello-Endor Route increasingly unstable, extending travel [[Time/Legends|times]] along it and frying the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]] of numerous [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. At some point following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="Endor" /> of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="TEA" /> [[Ur-Dean Emeritus]] [[Beryl Suttrige]] of<ref name="Endor" /> the planet<ref name="SWR">[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]</ref> [[Charmath]]'s [[College of Astrocartography]] expressed their interest in seeing the diamond core orbiting the Din Pulsar.<ref name="Endor" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Din Pulsar was first mentioned in the article "[[Endor and the Moddell Sector]]," which was published in the [[Star Wars Gamer 9|ninth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine<ref name="Endor" /> on [[February 22]], [[2002]].<ref name="GamerDate">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20020222.html|text=Starfighters Soar in Gamer #9}}</ref> In [[2008]], ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' claimed that the entity known as [[Tilotny]] existed near the Din Pulsar,<ref name="CSWE Tilotny">{{CSWECite|III|248|Tilotny}}</ref> but the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' overrode that placement by establishing that she resided near the [[Bedlam Pulsar/Legends|Bedlam Pulsar]] instead. ''The Essential Atlas'' also placed the Din Pulsar in grid square H-16.<ref name="TEA" />
